_comment: Budgets of je-bench-jobs and je-bench-memory (docs/specs/S06-jobs-memory.md R23-R26), je-bench-diag (S28 R26) and je-bench-particles (docs/specs/S20-particles.md R20-R26, AC10-AC12), measured with min(8, hardware threads - 2) workers on the build server's Linux x64 Release build. check_bench.py fails on a miss. je-bench-picking: docs/specs/S26-scene-view.md R28-R31, measured on the benchmark server E. je-bench-anim: docs/specs/S21-animation.md R19-R20 (AC12), measured on the benchmark server E with --workers 3 --count-allocs (docs/perf/animator.md).
